name: Airtable
shortInfo: Airtable is an easy-to-use online platform for creating and sharing relational databases.
brief: Airtable attempts to accelerate key workflows such as Product Roadmap or Marketing Campaigns and empowers teams to build custom apps on top of shared data.
about:
Airtable connector can be used to stream your data from Airtable into a user determined warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.x

Check about api documentation [here](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction).
availableData:
[Table Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/airtable/pipelines/table-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve records in a table contained in an Airtable base.
